messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Replace old strings if needed and tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑presented instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the whole body, headstock, neck, fretboard, and any unique features or flaws. Use natural light, a neutral background, and close‑ups of the soundhole, bridge, and electronics (if any). | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of returns. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores. Note prices for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Knowing the market helps you set a realistic asking price. | | **4. Write a Clear Listing** | Include:
• Brand, model, year, serial number (if known)
• Condition (new, like new, good, fair)
• Any upgrades or accessories (case, strap, tuner)
• Reason for selling
• Price (fixed or “best offer”)
• Shipping options (if you’ll ship) | Transparency builds trust and speeds up negotiations. | | **5. Choose Your Platforms** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, buyer protection.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music shops** – consignment or direct sale. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target price to allow room for negotiation. For example, if you want $300, list at $350. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point keeps you from underselling. | | **7. Offer Payment & Shipping Options** | • Cash or Venmo for local sales.
• PayPal, credit card, or bank transfer for online sales.
• Provide shipping quotes (UPS, USPS, FedEx) and insurance. | Clear payment terms reduce disputes and protect both parties. | | **8. Be Responsive & Safe** | Respond promptly to inquiries. Meet in a public place (coffee shop, police station) if selling locally. If shipping, use a reputable carrier and track the package. | Safety and professionalism increase buyer confidence. | | **9. Negotiate Wisely** | Stick to your minimum acceptable price. If a buyer offers less, politely explain why your price is fair. | You’ll avoid undervaluing your instrument while still closing the deal. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Once you agree on price, get a signed receipt or transaction confirmation. Ship immediately if online. | Documentation protects you and the buyer. | ### Quick Tips | Tip | How to Apply | |-----|--------------| | **Highlight Unique Features** | If your guitar has a special finish, custom inlay, or upgraded pickups, mention them. | | **Mention Upgrades** | New strings, a new case, or a recently replaced bridge can justify a higher price. | | **Use a Consignment Store** | If you’re not in a hurry, some shops will sell it for you and take a commission. | | **Offer a Trade‑In** | Some local shops will accept your guitar as part of the payment for a new one. | | **Keep Records** | Save all communications, receipts, and shipping documents. | ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2010 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 - Year: 2010 - Condition: Excellent (no scratches, no cracks) - Features: Solid spruce top, nato/okume back & sides, new strings (2019), included case - Reason for selling: Upgrading to a 12‑string Price: $350 (fixed) Shipping: Will ship via UPS Ground with insurance. Shipping cost $30. Payment: PayPal or Venmo. Local pickup available in [City]. Contact: [Your Name] – [Phone] – [Email] ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your own guitar’s specifics. Good luck with the sale!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can provide steps: research market value, clean it, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local classifieds), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention potential appraisal, trade-in, consignment. Provide tips for negotiation, payment methods, etc. No need to call function.
